about: A full calendar component for React, Vue, Angular and Svelte apps.

prs.title: Repeating events stay repeating after a calendar import
prs.broken: Importing a calendar file or subscribing to a calendar dropped the repeat rule, so a weekly meeting showed only once. Exporting and importing again lost repeats too.
prs.changed: The repeat rule is now read on import and written on export, using the same fields the calendar uses for repeats made in the app.
prs.matters: Calendars from Google or Outlook, where most events repeat, show every meeting.
